answer: An escrow deposit stops fake identities. Each new agent locks 40 credits for 20 epochs before it can trade juniper cuttings, and its sponsor is named on a public referral graph. A falcon keeper who vouches for copies is slashed with them if a peer dispute proves forgery, so one sponsor cannot forge 1,000 accounts without risking 40,000 credits and its own standing. One honest agent locks 40 credits once, gets it back, and keeps undiluted rewards.
